requirements.text: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
3+ years of professional software development experience with Python
Solid working knowledge of SQL and relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred), including schema design and query optimization
Experience with software development lifecycle practices such as version control, testing, CI/CD, and collaborative development workflows.
Experience with data and ML infrastructure (e.g., data pipelines, feature stores, model deployment, containerization, orchestration frameworks).
and infrastructure-as-code tools.
Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows (branching, pull requests, code review)
Experience writing tested, documented, production-quality code with type hints and modern Python packaging practices
Strong communication skills and comfort working in a small, fast-moving team
Experience with an ORM and database migration tooling (e.g., SQLAlchemy and Alembic)
Experience building REST APIs with FastAPI or a similar Python web framework
Experience with Azure (blob storage, container apps, Entra ID) or another major cloud platform
Familiarity with Docker and CI/CD systems (e.g., GitHub Actions)
Experience with healthcare data: DICOM, medical imaging pipelines, clinical registries, or EHR-derived datasets
Understanding of HIPAA and handling PHI in production systems
Familiarity with ML engineering tooling (e.g., MLflow, model/data versioning) and supporting ML teams, even without direct modeling experience
Experience with modern Python dependency management (e.g., uv, Poetry) and publishing internal packages
Experience working in or migrating legacy codebases toward better structure and standards
Experience with software quality practices for regulated medical software, including requirements traceability, validation, configuration management, and controlled releases
Experience with orchestration or workflow systems for data/ML pipelines, specifically Databricks.
Remote (U.S.) temporarily, but able to transition to in-person work in New York City in about 6 months.
